name: exec-prompts
title_zh: 拿到手是一支按步骤自动组队的执行小队
tagline_zh: 不用再手动复制粘贴每条 prompt。它读任务内容、自动分组、按序执行，适合多步骤工作流，省掉来回切换的麻烦。
tagline_en: Stop copy-pasting steps. It reads the bundle, forms teams, and executes in order—built for multi-step workflows.
desc_en: Use when executing prompts generated by make-prompts skill — reads a selected legacy or run-local prompt bundle, analyzes task content and method, forms agent teams, and executes steps. Trigger: /exec-prompts, "프롬프트 실행해줘", "exec-prompts 수행", "단계별 프롬프트 실행".
why_zh: 不是简单跑脚本，而是先分析任务内容和方法论，再动态组建 agent 小队，让每一步都有对应角色执行。
why_en: It doesn't just run scripts—it parses the task and method, then assembles purpose-fit agent teams per step, not a linear chain.
limit_zh: 只认 make-prompts 生成的 legacy 或 run-local 格式 bundle。
limit_en: Only reads legacy or run-local bundles from make-prompts. Requires a working agent backend; otherwise it stalls at team formation.
title_en: A team that auto-forms and runs your prompt steps
